_comment: Contextrail × Continue — copy to .continue/config.json and adjust apiBase / model. The un-suffixed file is gitignored. See docs/guides/local-frameworks.md.
systemMessage: Read LOCAL.md at the repo root before any edits. It is the slim Contextrail contract for local-tier agents — coordination, commit ceremony, header discipline, module-fit constraints. Do not invent process from training; the contract is the source of authority for this repo.

rules.name: claim-before-cross-module
rules.rule: Before editing files outside your single target module, file a claim via `node scripts/checks/claim-check.mjs --acquire --agent=<name> --slice=<id> --action=modify --targets=<paths>`. The pre-commit hook blocks commits that touch claimed files without your own claim. See LOCAL.md.

rules.name: commit-via-coa-merge
rules.rule: Use `node scripts/coa-merge.mjs --message="feat(module): description (TPL-XXX)"` for the commit ceremony. Do not bump VERSION, edit package.json's version field, or release CHANGELOG sections by hand. coa-merge handles pull, version bump, changelog release, claim auto-complete, and snapshot atomically.

rules.name: header-version-untouched
rules.rule: Never write `@version <number>` in file headers. Leave whatever value is there; the pre-commit hook stamps the right number from the VERSION file. Manually written versions collide with parallel sessions.

rules.name: small-slices-only
rules.rule: Owned scope is bounded slices inside one module at a time. If you find yourself wandering across more than two modules, stop and surface that to the operator — local-tier agents are scoped to bounded slices.
